mapper.select: SELECT P.PostID, P.AuthorID, P.Content, P.ImageURL, P.CreatedAt, P.UpdatedAt, P.LikesCount, P.RepostsCount, P.ReplyToPostID, U.Nickname AS authorNickname, U.Handle AS handle, U.ProfileImage AS profileImage FROM T_TRACE_POSTS P JOIN T_TRACE_USERS U ON P.AuthorID = U.UserID ORDER BY P.CreatedAt DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_TRACE_POSTS ( PostID, AuthorID, Content, ImageURL, CreatedAt ) VALUES ( T_TRACE_POSTS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{authorId}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT P.*, U.Nickname AS authorNickname, U.ProfileImage AS profileImage, U.Handle AS handle FROM T_TRACE_POSTS P JOIN T_TRACE_USERS U ON P.AuthorID = U.UserID WHERE P.Content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY P.CreatedAt DESC

SELECT P.*, U.Nickname, U.Handle, U.ProfileImage FROM T_TRACE_POSTS P JOIN T_TRACE_USERS U ON P.AuthorID = U.UserID WHERE LOWER(P.Content) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{category}) || '%' ORDER BY P.CreatedAt DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_TRACE_COMMENTS ( CommentID, PostID, WriterID, Content, CreatedAt ) VALUES ( T_TRACE_COMMENTS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
INSERT INTO T_TRACE_MENTIONS ( MentionID, PostID, CommentID, MentionedUserID, MentionedAt ) VALUES ( T_TRACE_MENTIONS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{postId}, #{commentId}, #{mentionedUserId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT MentionID, PostID, MentionedUserID, MentionedAt FROM T_TRACE_MENTIONS WHERE PostID = #{postId} ORDER BY MentionedAt ASC
SELECT Hashtag FROM T_TRACE_TRENDS WHERE Region = '대한민국' ORDER BY CollectedAt DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM T_TRACE_CHAT_MESSAGES WHERE ChatRoomID = #{chatRoomId} ORDER BY SentAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_TRACE_CHAT_MESSAGES ( MessageID, ChatRoomID, SenderID, Content, SentAt ) VALUES ( T_TRACE_CHAT_MESSAGES_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{chatRoomId}, #{senderId}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT COMMUNITY_ID AS communityId, Name AS name, Description AS description, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM T_TRACE_COMMUNITIES ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_TRACE_COMMUNITIES ( COMMUNITY_ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( T_TRACE_COMMUNITIES_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{name}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT n.NotificationID, n.UserID, n.Type, n.ReferenceID, n.IsRead, n.CreatedAt, ( CASE n.Type WHEN 'mention' THEN ( SELECT c.WriterID FROM T_TRACE_MENTIONS m JOIN T_TRACE_COMMENTS c ON c.CommentID = m.CommentID WHERE m.MentionID = n.ReferenceID ) WHEN 'like' THEN (SELECT l.UserID FROM T_TRACE_LIKES l WHERE l.LikeID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'retweet' THEN (SELECT r.UserID FROM T_TRACE_REPOSTS r WHERE r.RepostID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'follow' THEN (SELECT f.FollowerID FROM T_TRACE_FOLLOWS f WHERE f.FollowID = n.ReferenceID) END ) AS ACTOR_USER_ID, ( SELECT u.Nickname FROM T_TRACE_USERS u WHERE u.UserID = ( CASE n.Type WHEN 'mention' THEN ( SELECT c.WriterID FROM T_TRACE_MENTIONS m JOIN T_TRACE_COMMENTS c ON c.CommentID = m.CommentID WHERE m.MentionID = n.ReferenceID ) WHEN 'like' THEN (SELECT l.UserID FROM T_TRACE_LIKES l WHERE l.LikeID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'retweet' THEN (SELECT r.UserID FROM T_TRACE_REPOSTS r WHERE r.RepostID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'follow' THEN (SELECT f.FollowerID FROM T_TRACE_FOLLOWS f WHERE f.FollowID = n.ReferenceID) END ) ) AS ACTOR_NICKNAME, ( CASE n.Type WHEN 'mention' THEN (SELECT m.PostID FROM T_TRACE_MENTIONS m WHERE m.MentionID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'like' THEN (SELECT l.PostID FROM T_TRACE_LIKES l WHERE l.LikeID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'retweet' THEN (SELECT r.PostID FROM T_TRACE_REPOSTS r WHERE r.RepostID = n.ReferenceID) WHEN 'follow' THEN NULL END ) AS POST_ID FROM T_TRACE_NOTIFICATIONS n WHERE n.UserID = #{userId} ORDER BY n.CreatedAt DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_TRACE_NOTIFICATIONS WHERE UserID = #{userId} AND IsRead = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE T_TRACE_NOTIFICATIONS SET IsRead='Y' WHERE NotificationID = #{notificationId}
UPDATE T_TRACE_NOTIFICATIONS SET IsRead='Y' WHERE UserID = #{userId} AND IsRead='N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_TRACE_NOTIFICATIONS (NotificationID, UserID, Type, ReferenceID, IsRead, CreatedAt) VALUES (T_TRACE_NOTIFICATIONS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{type}, #{referenceId}, NVL(#{isRead}, 'N'), SYSDATE)

SELECT PostID, AuthorID, Content, ImageURL, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, LikesCount, RepostsCount, ReplyToPostID, Category FROM T_TRACE_POSTS WHERE AuthorID = #{userId} ORDER BY CreatedAt DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
